stage: frozen before target historical source or repair diff read
question: Can a one-revision, conditional-endian packed/aligned direct-embedding scan propose a reviewable representation check outside its bcachefs development lineage?
input_boundary: Only each selected parent revision and path are supplied to the scanner. No fix revision, fix diff, commit body, or title is passed to detection. The metadata-only selection pool already existed.

targets.selection_role: different-subsystem alignment candidate; two changed headers selected from metadata
different-subsystem endian scope control; changed C source selected from metadata

predeclared_interpretation: The scanner only recognizes conditional-endian packed plus numerically aligned types and direct named embeddings in the same input file. A path with no recognized sites is out of this rule's scope, not a normal or irrelevant commit.

A measured offset not divisible by declared type alignment is only a review candidate: packed wire/disk formats can intentionally do this. A measured divisible offset is normal only for this predicate and that site.
Compiler or parser failures are insufficient; missing input or an uncaught tool exception is runner_error. Neither can be converted to normal.

Primary unit is one independent historical causal chain per fix commit, not sites, files, ABI profiles, or test invocations. These purposefully chosen two commits cannot estimate accuracy, recall, or speedup.

Raw scan outputs must be saved before reading commit body, fix diff, or historical consumers for source review. Any later code change starts a new development iteration and needs another untouched holdout.
